headlights cut the dark. the vampire dentist — the block: crossbows under the tactical vests.
DRE / TUNDE / HALF-PINT
Dre: we're gonna eat. tell me we're gonna eat
▸ ENTRY — The way in is behind three dumpsters and a crawlspace.  (the alley was a dead end)

· flip   DRUM MAG  — “More bang before the click.”

KICKER → 3 cases of Blood X.  Tunde: [looks at it, looks at the sandwich, respects both]
RISKING: $24K + 3 crates   ·   crew: BANGED UP   ·   nothing lit
Dre: he looked at the pot. I looked at him. we're going, aren't we
→ TAKE THE WIN.

WOUNDED: Tunde limps away — because the lieutenant lifted his crew
